[[Kaya's Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Admiral Kaya]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (vs. [[Hex Spell|Hexed]] foes)
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Butterfly Knives]] from collectors [[Dauv Merishahl]], [[Jefri Whylir]] or [[Jung Zeng]]
*[[Crippling]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following sets of [[dagger]]s:
**[[Asuran Daggers]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Daggers]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Norn Daggers]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Split Chakrams]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Charr Daggers]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Tengu Daggers]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Crippling]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|Too Much Information]]" inscription

For daggers with the same stats that inflict [[Piercing damage]],
*Use [[Dirks]] from collectors [[Yiwong]], [[Kristoffir Roi]], or [[Jefri Whylir]] with the appropriate [[Dagger Tang]] and [[Dagger Handle]].
OR
*Use one of the following sets of daggers with the appropriate [[Dagger Tang]], [[Dagger Handle]], and [[Inscription]]:
**[[Bronze Daggers]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Deldrimor Daggers]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]

**[[Undead Daggers]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
